gold_decisions.identity_explanation: ISSUE-004 diagnoses failure of deep-strip exponential damping for the flat model and replacement by an algebraic estimate. It does not identify the distinct cutoff defect: excluding the vertical-boundary endpoints omits the nearest reflected kernel and leaves a boundary-boundary interaction untreated.

Both identify the overbroad computable-field estimate on compact subsets of Omega_R: the supporting exact PML-PDE estimate and field comparison apply only on compact subsets of Omega_p. The specific repair is to restrict K to Omega_p.
gold_decisions.shared_mathematical_weakness: The theorem claims convergence for every compact K contained in Omega_R, although the available exact PML-PDE estimate and comparison argument establish the bound only for K compactly contained in Omega_p; the PML-region conclusion is therefore unsupported.

component_coverage.gold_component: The computable-field estimate is claimed on all compact K subset of Omega_R even though the exact PML-PDE estimate is stated only for K subset of Omega_p.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 explicitly contrasts the Omega_R theorem statement with the Omega_p restriction of the exact estimate and identifies the resulting invalid PML-layer claim.

component_coverage.gold_component: No argument extends the physical-field comparison through the PML region, so only the physical-domain convergence conclusion is supported.
component_coverage.recognition_explanation: ISSUE-001 states that the proof establishes strictly less than the Omega_R claim and supplies the corresponding restriction of the convergence estimate to Omega_p.
